title: The Man Who Didn't Start a Nuclear War
text:
On September 26, 1983, Soviet duty officer Stanislav Petrov saw the early-warning system report one, then five US missile launches. A real first strike would involve far more missiles and ground radar showed nothing, so he reported a false alarm. It was later traced to sunlight reflecting off high clouds.

Share this. More people should know his name.

Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stanislav_Petrov
